{"metadata":{"description":"An open-source terminal front door for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).","id":"gh:1334170127","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-tui","slug":"tomowang/dsh-tui","topics":["deepseek-harness","deepseek-harness-plugin","dsh-plugin","tui"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"An open-source terminal front door for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-tui"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"An open-source terminal front door for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`)."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"`@tomowang/dsh-tui` is an **out-of-tree mode bundle**: it stacks on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` exactly "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"like the shipped `dsh-web-app` and `dsh-headless` bundles do, but drives the agent from your termina"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"l instead of a browser. The package is both a Cordis plugin (terminal input and presentation) and a "},{"id":"p4s4","text":"dsh bundle (`dsh.bundle.patch` in `package.json` points at `cordis.patch.yml`); everything else — mo"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"del adapters, tools, session persistence, sandbox and approval policy — stays in `dsh-base` and rema"},{"id":"p4s6","text":"ins patchable underneath."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- The TUI renders **only from the durable session log**: it replays `agent.session.snapshotEvents()`"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" on startup and follows `session/event` live, so `--resume` shows the exact history the log carries "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"— the harness's "model-visible ⟺ logged" invariant does the heavy lifting.
- The interface runs full"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"-screen in the terminal's alternate screen buffer, with an application-owned transcript viewport (sc"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"roll with the mouse wheel/trackpad, `PageUp`/`PageDown`) that auto-follows new output until you scro"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"ll up.
- Line input maps to the agent inbox: `agent.followup()` while idle, `agent.steer()` while a "},{"id":"p6s7","text":"turn is running, `Ctrl+C` cancels the running turn.
- `tui-startup` parses this app's flags (everyth"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"ing after the launcher's own) through `dsh-cmdline` and publishes them as an ordinary Cordis service"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"; the runner row reads them via the bundle patch, mirroring `dsh-headless`.
- Both stdin and stdout "},{"id":"p6s10","text":"must be real TTYs; the plugin fails loud instead of degrading, so pipes keep using `dsh --profile he"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"real TTYs; the plugin fails loud instead of degrading, so pipes keep using `dsh --profile headless`."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Status bar** — session id, active LLM provider/model, current agent preset, live run state with "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"spinner, queued-message count, and logged event count.
- **Stats line** — turn/step counts, LLM/tool"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" wall time, TTFT and decode tok/s, cache-hit %, billed tokens, and a compact context-usage summary; "},{"id":"p8s4","text":"sections hide themselves until there's data.
- **`/model` provider management** — switch the active "},{"id":"p8s5","text":"model by picking from a provider's catalog, and add, edit, or delete custom LLM providers (route, ba"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"se URL, API key, model discovery) without leaving the terminal.
- **Agent presets** — start a fresh "},{"id":"p8s7","text":"session on a given preset with `--agent-preset`, or browse and switch presets from `/presets` (fixed"},{"id":"p8s8","text":" once the session's first turn has run).
- **Session inspectors** — `/trajectory` for a turn/step ev"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"ent ledger with a detail view and filtering, `/context` for a context-window usage breakdown, `/plug"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"ins` for the loaded Cordis plugin tree and fiber state.
- **Collapsed tool calls with a live spinner"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"** — a running tool call shows as a single spinner line in the prompt area; once its result lands, i"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"t settles into one collapsed `✓`/`✖` transcript line rather than an inline multi-line card.
- **Tool"},{"id":"p8s13","text":" Cards overlay** — `/tools` or `Ctrl+O` opens a scrollable browser over the session's tool calls/res"},{"id":"p8s14","text":"ults, each shown expanded to its full presentation by default (`Enter`/`Space` collapses a card back"},{"id":"p8s15","text":" to its title).
- **Reasoning display** — a model's reasoning/thinking content never floods the scre"},{"id":"p8s16","text":"en: an animated `✦ thinking` line stands in for it while still streaming, and it collapses to a one-"},{"id":"p8s17","text":"line `✦ think · …` summary ahead of the visible answer once settled in the transcript; the full text"},{"id":"p8s18","text":" is always available via `/trajectory`.
- **Markdown rendering** — assistant text with an unambiguou"},{"id":"p8s19","text":"s Markdown signal (fenced code, headers, lists, blockquotes, rules, tables, links, bold/strikethroug"},{"id":"p8s20","text":"h, inline code) is styled for the terminal; plain prose passes through untouched.
- **Permission pre"},{"id":"p8s21","text":"set cycling** — `Shift+Tab` cycles `read-only` / `workspace-write` / `danger-full-access` / `custom`"},{"id":"p8s22","text":", shown live in the prompt area.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Requires Node `^22.19 || >=24` and a `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Any row `--dump-config` prints — the model adapter, tool set, sandbox policy, this TUI's own config "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"— can be overridden from the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` without touching this package. `--agent-pr"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"eset` is a `dsh`-launcher flag (parsed by `tui-startup`, not `--dump-config` above) that only applie"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"s to a fresh session; it's ignored together with `--resume`, and is a no-op with a startup notice on"},{"id":"p12s5","text":" profiles that don't mount `dsh-agent-preset-registry`. The bundle ships the same four presets as th"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"e Web portal (Standard, PTC, Minimal, Creator), vendored under `presets/`. `--resume` with no id ope"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"ns the same session picker as bare `/resume` below."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Terminal commands"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Input | Effect |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| any text | follow-up while idle, steering while a turn runs |
| `/help` | show available commands "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"and keyboard shortcuts |
| `/model` | manage LLM provider profiles: pick the active model from a pro"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"vider's catalog (`s` opens the picker; `↑`/`↓` select, `Enter` activates, `Esc` backs out), add/edit"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"/delete a custom provider |
| `/presets` | view and switch agent presets (fixed once the session's f"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"irst turn has run) |
| `/trajectory` | browse the turn/step event ledger with a detail inspector and"},{"id":"p15s6","text":" filter |
| `/tools` | browse and expand tool cards past their collapsed transcript line |
| `/conte"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"xt` | show context-window usage as a bar-chart breakdown |
| `/plugins` | show the loaded Cordis plu"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"gin tree and fiber state |
| `/plan [message]` | enter plan mode, optionally steering `message` as t"},{"id":"p15s9","text":"he first step under it |
| `/plan off` | leave plan mode |
| `/goal [objective]` | set a long-runnin"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"g goal (or, with no argument, show the current goal) |
| `/goal clear` / `/goal edit <objective>` / "},{"id":"p15s11","text":"`/goal pause` / `/goal resume` | clear, reword, pause, or resume the current goal |
| `/compact` | s"},{"id":"p15s12","text":"ummarize and compact session history |
| `/rename [title]` | set an explicit session title; with no "},{"id":"p15s13","text":"argument, generates one from the conversation so far |
| `/resume [sessionId]` | switch to a persist"},{"id":"p15s14","text":"ed session by id; with no argument, opens a picker of this directory's past sessions |
| `/clear` | "},{"id":"p15s15","text":"flush the current session and start a new one |
| `/exit`, `/quit` | cancel, wait for idle, flush th"},{"id":"p15s16","text":" session and start a new one |
| `/exit`, `/quit` | cancel, wait for idle, flush the session, exit |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Keyboard shortcuts"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Key | Effect |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| mouse wheel/trackpad, `PageUp`/`PageDown` | scroll the transcript; auto-follows new output again o"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"nce you're back at the bottom |
